title: Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies Dissolution Amendment Ordinance 1997

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies Dissolution Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PUNJAB UNDESIRABLE COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES (DISSOLUTION) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
PUNJAB UNDESIRABLE COOPERATIVE
SOCIETIES (DISSOLUTION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 20th May, 1997]
No. Legis.3(XIX)/97, dated 20‑5‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information.
Whereas, it is expedient to amend
the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 (Act I of
1993) as hereinafter appearing;
And whereas, the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and the Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render immediate action necessary.
Now therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred on him under Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) (Amendment) Ordinance,
1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the day the Punjab Undesirable
Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) (Amendment) Ordinance 1997 (IX of 1997)
stands repealed under Article 128(2) of the Constitution..

Amendment of section 2 of Act I of 1993

PUNJAB UNDESIRABLE COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES (DISSOLUTION) (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
PUNJAB UNDESIRABLE COOPERATIVE
SOCIETIES (DISSOLUTION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 20th May, 1997]
No. Legis.3(XIX)/97, dated 20‑5‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information.
Whereas, it is expedient to amend
the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993 (Act I of
1993) as hereinafter appearing;
And whereas, the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and the Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render immediate action necessary.
Now therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred on him under Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Act I of 1993.‑‑In the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies
(6issolution) Act, 1993, in section 2, in subsection (1), for clause (c), the
following shall be substituted:‑‑
"(c)
'Cooperative Judge' means a Judge of the Lahore High Court, Lahore functioning
as a Company Judge and nominated as Cooperatives Judge by the Chief Justice of
the said High Court.".
